selection_process: The selection process comprises the following stages:

Stage-I: OMR based Written examination of 175 marks with multiple choice objective type questions (Duration: 3 Hours). Candidates will be shortlisted at the ratio of 1:2 of the vacancy position. Stage-II: Computer skill test of 25 marks for the shortlisted candidates. Final Selection: Based on total marks secured in the written examination and computer skill test as per merit and reservations.

exam_pattern.details: Exam Pattern Notes: The total number of questions will remain 150. There will be negative marking for wrong answers equivalent to 1/4th of the marks allotted for that question. Selecting more than one option will be treated as a wrong answer. Question papers will be available in Assamese, Bengali, English, Bodo, and Hindi.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.sebaonline.org to access the prescribed online application form.
Fill up all mandatory fields carefully in the online application form.
Ensure all entered details including Gender and Category are correct, as no editing or resubmission is allowed after final submission.
Submit the online application form to receive a Unique Application Number for future reference.
Keep a record of the Unique Application Number and download the confirmation for your records.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted in online mode only; no other mode is allowed. The Commission will not be responsible for any technical lapses during online application submission. Candidates already in regular Government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) when asked. Candidates must submit a declaration regarding "The Small Family Norms" in Form-A when asked. Canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify a candidate. There will be no preference for place of posting.

faq.question: Q1. What is SLRC Field Assistant/ Enumerator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by the State Level Recruitment Commission for Class-III Posts under the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam to fill 72 temporary vacancies for Field Assistant (Statistics)/ Enumerator posts under the Integrated Sample Survey (ISS) scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SLRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 72 vacancies are available for the Field Assistant (Statistics)/ Enumerator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SLRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 14 November 2026 (23.59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for SLRC Field Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university with at least a paper in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Social Science, Sociology, or Psychology at the Graduate level, OR a Bachelor's Degree in any subject with 50% marks in Mathematics at the 12th standard, along with knowledge of English and local language, a 6-month computer certificate, and handheld device data keying comfort.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SLRC Field Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not less than 21 years of age and not more than 40 years of age as on 01/01/2026, subject to category-wise relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SLRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, candidates of any category do not have to pay any application fee for the examination.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for SLRC Field Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal at www.sebaoonline.org between 15 October 2026 and 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SLRC Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application scrutiny, a written examination, and merit list preparation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for SLRC Field Assistant/ Enumerator?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive pay in Pay Band-2 ranging from Rs. 14,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- plus a Grade Pay of Rs. 5,600/- along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q10. Are these posts permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The posts are created under the centrally sponsored scheme "Integrated Sample Survey (ISS)" of the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam with a 90:10 sharing pattern between the Central and State Government.
